Let me try: move LEFT 7 times (to reach the left edge), then see what happens.
Actually, let me reconsider the level structure. The player is on a blue platform at the bottom. The green blocks are on a separate platform above. The purple blocks are at the very top. What if the player needs to "collect" something from the green blocks and deliver it to the purple blocks?
But I can't move the player up/down, only left/right. So the player can't reach the green or purple blocks.
Wait, what if MOUSE clicks can be used to "shoot" or "destroy" blocks from a distance? That's what I've been doing - clicking green blocks removes them. But I need to remove all 14 in 7 actions.
What if I can click a SINGLE position that clears ALL blocks? Like clicking the center of the green block region?
Let me try clicking the exact center of the green block region. The green blocks span from col 15 to col 51 (7 blocks, each 6 cols apart = 42 cols, so center is around col 33). The rows are 27 and 33, so the center row is 30.
